_readme: Curated manifest for ClawTweaksSetup.exe ('ClawTweaks Center'). Fetched from the master branch via raw.githubusercontent on every Center launch (Core/SetupVersionCheck.cs). Offline-safe: if unreachable, Center runs normally and offers no update. NOTE: this file is only live once pushed to the PUBLIC repo's master branch - pushing it to the private dev remote changes nothing.
_readme_floor: minimumSetupVersion is a FLOOR, not the latest version. Center shows an 'outdated build' warning when its own <Version> (ClawTweaksSetup.csproj - NOT the same number as the ClawTweaks app version) is below it. Only bump it when an older Center build is known broken, e.g. a fixed install-routine bug, so already-downloaded builds get flagged. Do NOT bump it on every release.
_readme_update: The latestSetup* fields drive the self-update offer on Center's Home screen (Core/CenterUpdater.cs). ALL of latestSetupVersion, latestSetupUrl and latestSetupSha256 must be present and valid or no update is offered at all - a half-filled entry must never produce an Update button that then can't verify what it downloaded. Release procedure: (1) bump <Version> in ClawTweaksSetup.csproj, (2) dotnet publish -c Release, (3) upload ClawTweaksSetup\PortableExe\CTW_Center_<version>_Setup.exe as a GitHub release asset, (4) Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 on that exact uploaded file, (5) fill the three fields below and push to public master. The URL must be https on github.com / objects.githubusercontent.com / release-assets.githubusercontent.com and end in .exe - SetupVersionCheck.SanitizeUrl rejects anything else, because this is an untrusted string we are about to download an executable from.
message: This ClawTweaks Center build is outdated and known to have issues. Please download the latest build from GitHub.
latestSetupNotes: Center can now update itself: it downloads the new build, verifies its checksum, and starts it for you.
